title: MultiHateLoc: Towards Temporal Localisation of Multimodal Hate Content in Online Videos

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a multimodal model's ability to temporally localize hateful content (defined as communication attacking groups based on race, gender, religion, or other identities) in online videos, measured using frame-level Mean Average Precision (mAP) and Area Under the Curve (AUC) on the HateMM and MultiHateClip datasets.
